narrative.intro: Clark Construction Group obligated $495M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Clark Construction Group won 17 awards, with an average award size of $29.1M, and obligations were up 0.6% year over year. The Department of Defense bought the most from Clark Construction Group with $415M in obligations, followed by the General Services Administration with $76.9M. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market for Clark Construction Group at $316M, followed by Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction at $145M and Site Preparation Contractors at $33.7M. Obligations by fiscal year for Clark Construction Group were $167M in FY21, $178M in FY22, $603M in FY23, $1.6B in FY24, $492M in FY25, and $495M in FY26. The current-year totals are partial, covering the fiscal year to date, and the listed award values in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligations.

sections.heading: Who are Clark Construction Group's biggest federal customers?
sections.body: The Department of Defense is the biggest buyer from Clark Construction Group, with $415M in obligations. The General Services Administration follows with $76.9M. Smaller buyers include the Smithsonian Institution with $1.6M and the Department of Justice with $1.2M, plus other agencies listed at lower amounts.

sections.heading: What types of work does Clark Construction Group sell to the government?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market for Clark Construction Group at $316M. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounted for $145M, and Site Preparation Contractors accounted for $33.7M. These markets represent the core of Clark Construction Group's federal work in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: How much does Clark Construction Group make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Clark Construction Group made $495M from federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Clark Construction Group won 17 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $29.1M and obligations up 0.6% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Clark Construction Group?
faq.a: The Department of Defense is Clark Construction Group's top federal customer, with $415M in obligations. The General Services Administration is the next-largest buyer with $76.9M, and other buyers include the Smithsonian Institution with $1.6M and the Department of Justice with $1.2M.

faq.q: What does Clark Construction Group sell to the government?
faq.a: Clark Construction Group sells building and heavy-civil construction services to the government. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounted for $316M, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounted for $145M, and Site Preparation Contractors accounted for $33.7M.
